messages:
jamie: heads-up — nightly SAST/DAST produced 120 findings but 18 artifacts failed to decrypt. evidence bundle incomplete, blocking triage. anyone seen KMS issues?
security-bot: [alert] nightly-scan 3062469299 - 120 findings, 18 artifacts decrypt_failed (KMS::AccessDenied). CI link: https://ci.internal/nightly/3062469299
lucas: we shipped a small RBAC tighten for role scanner-sa last night. likely removed kms:Decrypt binding. i'll check the keystore policy.
mike: job logs show: ```
[2026-03-23T02:14:01Z] KMS Error: AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:iam::1111:role/scanner-sa not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt
```
sara: suggested play: (1) don't re-run whole night yet, collect logs (2) apply a timeboxed minimal grant to scanner-sa scoped to the CI principal (3) re-run failing job for auth-service only (4) attach evidence and update vuln tickets + incident.
lucas: i can create a one-off grant with expiry and condition. example: ```aws kms create-grant --key-id abc123 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::1111:role/scanner-sa --operations Decrypt``` will expire on manual retire.
oncall: opening INC-2026-045, taking ownership. will coordinate the temporary grant window and notify eng-leads.
mike: kicked off single repo re-run: https://ci.internal/job/scan/auth-service/3872
mike: re-run succeeded, artifacts decrypted and attached. no new findings introduced.
sara: action items: lucas tighten least-privilege for scanner with CI smoke-test; add RBAC change notif to change-control; postmortem with timeline. target EOD.
jamie: thanks. keep the thread for postmortem link. :thumbsup:
